definition.def: If you indulge in something or if you indulge yourself, you allow yourself to have or do something that you know you will enjoy.
examples: We had enough time to indulge in a bit of window shopping. [VERB + in]
He returned to Britain so that he could indulge his passion for football. [VERB noun]
You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune. [VERB pronoun-reflexive]

definition.def: If you indulge someone, you let them have or do what they want, even if this is not good for them.
examples: He did not agree with indulging children. [VERB noun]

examples.sentence: Playfulness, it seems, is common only among mammals, although a few of the larger-brained birds also indulge.
